prompt:
Edit this transparent painted tactical RPG knight pose sheet, preserving the same brown-haired young man's face, slender adult anatomy, blue tabard with gold trim, steel/bronze armor, leather belt, gloves, and modest boots. Output exactly TWENTY separate full-body sprites in FOUR columns and FIVE rows with wide transparent gaps, same tactical camera/light and correct views. Each ROW has the same facing: row1 front-right 3/4 SE, row2 straight front S, row3 true right profile E, row4 rear-right 3/4 NE, row5 straight back N. Do not mix these facings.
Columns1-2 are two subtly different neutral breathing drawings; columns3-4 are two subtly different combat breathing drawings. Keep planted feet and identical leg placement between the two drawings of each stance; animate only subtle upper breathing, no stepping or drift. Important correction to columns1-2: the sword is DRAWN and clearly carried LOWERED in his RIGHT gloved hand beside the right leg, hilt near upper thigh/hip, blade diagonally down and slightly outward, pointed tip at least10px above the boots' ground line. Left hand relaxed. Do NOT leave hands empty, do NOT put the sword between the legs, do NOT sheath it, do NOT hold it raised. Match the relaxed lowered carry of a sword/shield or axe warrior but he has NO shield. Rear views naturally occlude parts of hand/blade.
Important correction to columns3-4: retain the selected forward TWO-HANDED sword guard A, both gloves gripping the same hilt near abdomen, elbows relaxed and blade rigid diagonally forward/up in the facing direction. Give him an unmistakable credible FIGHTING STANCE: feet shoulder-width or a little wider, one foot forward and one back, weight balanced, slightly flexed knees and hips, clear gap between thighs and boots. Increase frontal/SE boot center separation around50-70% relative to the narrow original, about60-75px between boot centers for a171px tall figure; side view shows a clear fore/aft stagger. Do NOT make parallel legs touching, a sumo split, bowed legs or enlarged boots. Back view also shows a stable broad staggered base with shoulders facing away. Sword full length consistent, no scabbard mistaken for blade.
Do not redesign face, costume, palette or painterly finish. Full heads, boots, hilt and sword tips inside each cell, all20 figures disconnected by clear alpha, no text/labels/grid/floor/shadow/background. Actual transparent alpha.

Edit the FIRST transparent painted knight walking sheet. Preserve all FORTY full-body sequential walk poses, four columns and ten rows, same brown-haired male knight, face, blue/gold tabard, metal armor, gloves and reasonable boots. The second image is the corrected neutral/ready stance identity reference: use its LOWERED NEUTRAL sword carry only, not its raised combat guard. This sheet is NEUTRAL walking, not fighting.
Each TWO-row group is one complete eight-pose alternating walk cycle in a fixed facing: rows1-2 front-right SE; rows3-4 straight front S toward camera; rows5-6 true right profile E; rows7-8 rear-right NE; rows9-10 straight back N away from camera. Preserve these exact facings and chronological left-right heel strike, planted weight, passing foot, next heel strike. Smooth broad natural adult brisk steps, balanced torso, modest vertical motion, no high-knee running or fast cartoon foot churn. Frames0 and4 show opposite foot contacts. Full cycle represents two natural strides, not eight shuffling steps.
The specific correction is weapon carry: in EVERY frame his RIGHT gloved hand HOLDS the SAME drawn rigid long sword LOWERED beside his right thigh, hilt at hip/upper thigh and blade diagonally down and gently outward, tip above the floor line, clear of boots. Left arm swings modestly. Never empty hands, never sword upright between thighs, never two hands raised in the ready guard, no shield. Keep sword length stable; walking changes hand/arm position naturally and the sword travels with the hand. At front/back angles foreshorten/occlude it coherently without making it disappear. Keep the original identity, pose volume, painted style, camera, anatomy and material palette. Exactly40 disconnected full-body figures, no clipped weapons/boots, generous transparent gaps, no text/grid/background/ground/shadow. Actual transparent alpha.
